messages.subject: plot utilization

How do you arrange the order of the bars when plotting resource utilization?

messages.author: 0f5b7adb7e70bd8b
messages.subject: Re: [simmer-devel] plot utilization
parts:
2018-03-28 14:07 GMT+02:00 S934 <sashra...@gmail.com>:
> Hi
>
> How do you arrange the order of the bars when plotting resource utilization?

simmer.plot uses ggplot2 as backend, so you can do whatever you would
do with a ggplot2 object. Factors (e.g., bars in the utilization plot)
are sorted by default. If you want another ordering, you can convert
the data frame's resource column to factors with the levels you want
(see ?factor).

Iñaki

>
> Thanks
>
> S

2018-03-28 16:36 GMT+02:00 S934 <sashra...@gmail.com>:
> Thanks but which data frame does
> plot(env, what = "resources", metric = "utilization")
> use so I know the resources column to convert to factors etc?

With the latest version, you should get a warning saying that this
syntax is deprecated. The new syntax is as follows:

resources <- get_mon_resources(env)
plot(resources, metric="utilization")
